paragraphs.en: OpenBao is a software solution to manage, store, and distribute sensitive data including secrets, certificates, and keys.
paragraphs.zh: OpenBao 是一款用于管理、存储和分发敏感数据（包括密钥、证书和密钥）的软件解决方案。

paragraphs.en: Please note : We take OpenBao's security and our users' trust very seriously. If you believe you have found a security issue in OpenBao, please responsibly disclose by contacting us at openbao-security@lists.openssf.org .
paragraphs.zh: 请注意：我们非常重视 OpenBao 的安全性以及用户的信任。 如果您认为您在 OpenBao 中发现了安全问题，请通过 openbao-security@lists.openssf.org 联系我们，负责任地进行披露。

paragraphs.en: OpenBao is a software solution to manage, store, and distribute sensitive data including secrets, certificates, and keys. The OpenBao community intends to provide this software under an OSI-approved open-source license, led by a community run under open-governance principles.
paragraphs.zh: OpenBao 是一款用于管理、存储和分发敏感数据（包括机密信息、证书和密钥）的软件解决方案。 OpenBao 社区计划在一种经 OSI 认可的开源许可证下提供该软件，并由一个遵循开放治理原则运行的社区主导。

sents.en: OpenBao is a software solution to manage, store, and distribute sensitive data including secrets, certificates, and keys.
sents.zh: OpenBao 是一款用于管理、存储和分发敏感数据（包括机密信息、证书和密钥）的软件解决方案。

sents.en: The OpenBao community intends to provide this software under an OSI-approved open-source license, led by a community run under open-governance principles.
sents.zh: OpenBao 社区计划在一种经 OSI 认可的开源许可证下提供该软件，并由一个遵循开放治理原则运行的社区主导。

paragraphs.en: A modern system requires access to a multitude of secrets: database credentials, API keys for external services, credentials for service-oriented architecture communication, etc. Understanding who is accessing what secrets is already very difficult and platform-specific. Adding on key rolling, secure storage, and detailed audit logs is almost impossible without a custom solution. This is where OpenBao steps in.
paragraphs.zh: 现代系统需要访问大量的密钥：数据库凭据、外部服务的 API 密钥、面向服务架构通信的凭据等。 了解谁在访问哪些密钥本身就已非常困难，且因平台而异。 在没有自定义解决方案的情况下，再叠加密钥轮换、安全存储和详细审计日志，几乎是不可能实现的。 这正是 OpenBao 发挥作用的地方。

sents.en: A modern system requires access to a multitude of secrets: database credentials, API keys for external services, credentials for service-oriented architecture communication, etc.
sents.zh: 现代系统需要访问大量的密钥：数据库凭据、外部服务的 API 密钥、面向服务架构通信的凭据等。

sents.en: Understanding who is accessing what secrets is already very difficult and platform-specific.
sents.zh: 了解谁在访问哪些密钥本身就已非常困难，且因平台而异。

sents.en: Adding on key rolling, secure storage, and detailed audit logs is almost impossible without a custom solution.
sents.zh: 在没有自定义解决方案的情况下，再叠加密钥轮换、安全存储和详细审计日志，几乎是不可能实现的。

sents.en: This is where OpenBao steps in.
sents.zh: 这正是 OpenBao 发挥作用的地方。

paragraphs.en: Secure Secret Storage : Arbitrary key/value secrets can be stored in OpenBao. OpenBao encrypts these secrets prior to writing them to persistent storage, so gaining access to the raw storage isn't enough to access your secrets. OpenBao can write to disk, PostgreSQL , and more.
paragraphs.zh: 安全密钥存储：任意键/值密钥都可以存储在 OpenBao 中。 OpenBao 在将这些密钥写入持久化存储之前会对其进行加密，因此仅获得对原始存储的访问权限并不足以访问你的密钥。 OpenBao 可以写入磁盘、PostgreSQL 等多种后端。

sents.en: Secure Secret Storage : Arbitrary key/value secrets can be stored in OpenBao.
sents.zh: 安全密钥存储：任意键/值密钥都可以存储在 OpenBao 中。

sents.en: OpenBao encrypts these secrets prior to writing them to persistent storage, so gaining access to the raw storage isn't enough to access your secrets.
sents.zh: OpenBao 在将这些密钥写入持久化存储之前会对其进行加密，因此仅获得对原始存储的访问权限并不足以访问你的密钥。

sents.en: OpenBao can write to disk, PostgreSQL , and more.
sents.zh: OpenBao 可以写入磁盘、PostgreSQL 等多种后端。

paragraphs.en: Dynamic Secrets : OpenBao can generate secrets on-demand for some systems, such as AWS or SQL databases. For example, when an application needs to access an S3 bucket, it asks OpenBao for credentials, and OpenBao will generate an AWS keypair with valid permissions on demand. After creating these dynamic secrets, OpenBao will also automatically revoke them after the lease is up.
paragraphs.zh: 动态密钥：OpenBao 可以为某些系统（例如 AWS 或 SQL 数据库）按需生成密钥。 例如，当应用程序需要访问 S3 存储桶时，它会向 OpenBao 请求凭证，OpenBao 会按需生成一个具有有效权限的 AWS 密钥对。 在创建这些动态密钥之后，OpenBao 还会在租约到期后自动撤销它们。

sents.en: Dynamic Secrets : OpenBao can generate secrets on-demand for some systems, such as AWS or SQL databases.
sents.zh: 动态密钥：OpenBao 可以为某些系统（例如 AWS 或 SQL 数据库）按需生成密钥。

sents.en: For example, when an application needs to access an S3 bucket, it asks OpenBao for credentials, and OpenBao will generate an AWS keypair with valid permissions on demand.
sents.zh: 例如，当应用程序需要访问 S3 存储桶时，它会向 OpenBao 请求凭证，OpenBao 会按需生成一个具有有效权限的 AWS 密钥对。

sents.en: After creating these dynamic secrets, OpenBao will also automatically revoke them after the lease is up.
sents.zh: 在创建这些动态密钥之后，OpenBao 还会在租约到期后自动撤销它们。

paragraphs.en: Data Encryption : OpenBao can encrypt and decrypt data without storing it. This allows security teams to define encryption parameters and developers to store encrypted data in a location such as a SQL database without having to design their own encryption methods.
paragraphs.zh: 数据加密：OpenBao 可以在不存储数据的情况下对数据进行加密和解密。 这使得安全团队能够定义加密参数，开发人员则可以将加密数据存储在诸如 SQL 数据库等位置，而无需自行设计加密方法。

sents.en: Data Encryption : OpenBao can encrypt and decrypt data without storing it.
sents.zh: 数据加密：OpenBao 可以在不存储数据的情况下对数据进行加密和解密。

sents.en: This allows security teams to define encryption parameters and developers to store encrypted data in a location such as a SQL database without having to design their own encryption methods.
sents.zh: 这使得安全团队能够定义加密参数，开发人员则可以将加密数据存储在诸如 SQL 数据库等位置，而无需自行设计加密方法。

paragraphs.en: Leasing and Renewal : All secrets in OpenBao have a lease associated with them. At the end of the lease, OpenBao will automatically revoke that secret. Clients are able to renew leases via built-in renew APIs.
paragraphs.zh: 租约与续期：OpenBao 中的所有机密都有一个与之关联的租约。 租约到期后，OpenBao 会自动撤销该机密。 客户端可以通过内置的续期 API 续约租约。

sents.en: Leasing and Renewal : All secrets in OpenBao have a lease associated with them.
sents.zh: 租约与续期：OpenBao 中的所有机密都有一个与之关联的租约。

sents.en: At the end of the lease, OpenBao will automatically revoke that secret.
sents.zh: 租约到期后，OpenBao 会自动撤销该机密。

sents.en: Clients are able to renew leases via built-in renew APIs.
sents.zh: 客户端可以通过内置的续期 API 续约租约。

paragraphs.en: Revocation : OpenBao has built-in support for secret revocation. OpenBao can revoke not only single secrets, but a tree of secrets, for example, all secrets read by a specific user, or all secrets of a particular type. Revocation assists in key rolling as well as locking down systems in the case of an intrusion.
paragraphs.zh: 吊销：OpenBao 内置了对机密吊销的支持。 OpenBable 不仅可以吊销单个机密，还可以吊销一整棵机密树，例如某个特定用户读取的所有机密，或某一特定类型的所有机密。 吊销有助于密钥轮换，以及在发生入侵时锁定系统。

sents.en: Revocation : OpenBao has built-in support for secret revocation.
sents.zh: 吊销：OpenBao 内置了对机密吊销的支持。

sents.en: OpenBao can revoke not only single secrets, but a tree of secrets, for example, all secrets read by a specific user, or all secrets of a particular type.
sents.zh: OpenBable 不仅可以吊销单个机密，还可以吊销一整棵机密树，例如某个特定用户读取的所有机密，或某一特定类型的所有机密。

sents.en: Revocation assists in key rolling as well as locking down systems in the case of an intrusion.
sents.zh: 吊销有助于密钥轮换，以及在发生入侵时锁定系统。

paragraphs.en: Documentation is available on the OpenBao website .
paragraphs.zh: 文档可在 OpenBao 网站上获取 。

paragraphs.en: Before submitting pull requests to OpenBao, ensure that you have read and understood our contribution guidelines described in CONTRIBUTING.md . A failure to do so will likely result in your pull request being rejected.
paragraphs.zh: 在向 OpenBao 提交拉取请求之前，请确保您已阅读并理解 CONTRIBUTING.md 中描述的贡献指南。 若未遵守，您的拉取请求很可能会被拒绝。

sents.en: Before submitting pull requests to OpenBao, ensure that you have read and understood our contribution guidelines described in CONTRIBUTING.md .
sents.zh: 在向 OpenBao 提交拉取请求之前，请确保您已阅读并理解 CONTRIBUTING.md 中描述的贡献指南。

sents.en: A failure to do so will likely result in your pull request being rejected.
sents.zh: 若未遵守，您的拉取请求很可能会被拒绝。

paragraphs.en: If you wish to work on OpenBao itself or any of its built-in systems, you'll first need Go installed on your machine. The Go toolchain version used in CI and releases is pinned at .go-version , but using the latest toolchain available for local development is typically fine.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你想参与 OpenBao 本身或其任一内置系统的开发，首先需要在你的机器上安装 Go。 CI 和发布中使用的 Go 工具链版本固定在 .go-version 文件中，但在本地开发中使用可获得的最新工具链通常也没有问题。

sents.en: If you wish to work on OpenBao itself or any of its built-in systems, you'll first need Go installed on your machine.
sents.zh: 如果你想参与 OpenBao 本身或其任一内置系统的开发，首先需要在你的机器上安装 Go。

sents.en: The Go toolchain version used in CI and releases is pinned at .go-version , but using the latest toolchain available for local development is typically fine.
sents.zh: CI 和发布中使用的 Go 工具链版本固定在 .go-version 文件中，但在本地开发中使用可获得的最新工具链通常也没有问题。

paragraphs.en: OpenBao uses Go Modules , so it is recommended that you clone the repository outside of the GOPATH.
paragraphs.zh: OpenBao 使用 Go Modules，因此建议将代码仓库克隆到 GOPATH 之外。

paragraphs.en: $ mkdir -p bin $ go build -o bin/bao . To run the OpenBao server in development mode:
paragraphs.zh: $ mkdir -p bin $ go build -o bin/bao . 要以开发模式运行 OpenBao 服务器：

sents.en: $ mkdir -p bin $ go build -o bin/bao .
sents.zh: $ mkdir -p bin $ go build -o bin/bao .

sents.en: To run the OpenBao server in development mode:
sents.zh: 要以开发模式运行 OpenBao 服务器：

paragraphs.en: $ go run . server -dev # Or `./bin/bao server -dev` if you've built the binary already. Since OpenBao is a large codebase that takes a short while to compile from a cold cache, it is useful to attach the -v flag to build commands to get a better sense of compilation progress.
paragraphs.zh: $ go run . server -dev # 如果已经构建了二进制文件，也可以使用 `./bin/bao server -dev`。 由于 OpenBao 是一个大型代码库，从冷缓存编译需要一段时间，因此在构建命令中附加 -v 标志有助于更好地了解编译进度。

sents.en: $ go run . server -dev # Or `./bin/bao server -dev` if you've built the binary already.
sents.zh: $ go run . server -dev # 如果已经构建了二进制文件，也可以使用 `./bin/bao server -dev`。

sents.en: Since OpenBao is a large codebase that takes a short while to compile from a cold cache, it is useful to attach the -v flag to build commands to get a better sense of compilation progress.
sents.zh: 由于 OpenBao 是一个大型代码库，从冷缓存编译需要一段时间，因此在构建命令中附加 -v 标志有助于更好地了解编译进度。

paragraphs.en: $ go test ./some/package Some additional notes on development:
paragraphs.zh: $ go test ./some/package 关于开发的一些补充说明：

paragraphs.en: This repository publishes two libraries that may be imported by other projects: github.com/openbao/openbao/api/v2 and github.com/openbao/openbao/sdk/v2 .
paragraphs.zh: 该仓库发布了两个可供其他项目导入的库：github.com/openbao/openbao/api/v2 和 github.com/openbao/openbao/sdk/v2。

paragraphs.en: Note that this repository also contains OpenBao (the application), and as with most Go projects, OpenBao uses Go modules to manage its dependencies. The mechanism to do that is the go.mod file. As it happens, the presence of that file also makes it theoretically possible to import OpenBao as a dependency into other projects. Some other projects have made a practice of doing so in order to take advantage of testing tooling that was developed for testing OpenBao itself. This is NOT, and has NEVER been, a supported way to use the OpenBao project. We will not fix bugs relating to failure to import github.com/openbao/openbao into your project or refactor internal code to make this easier to do.
paragraphs.zh: 请注意，此仓库还包含 OpenBao（应用程序本身），并且与大多数 Go 项目一样，OpenBao 使用 Go 模块来管理其依赖。 实现这一机制的文件是 go.mod。 巧的是，该文件的存在也使得在理论上可以将 OpenBao 作为依赖导入到其他项目中。 一些其他项目已经将这种做法常态化，以便利用为测试 OpenBao 本身而开发的测试工具。 这不是，也从来都不是，一种受支持的 OpenBao 项目使用方式。 我们不会修复因无法将 github.com/openbao/openbao 导入您的项目而产生的缺陷，也不会为了便于这样做而重构内部代码。
